Bill.BriefDescription: Prohibiting commercial motor vehicles in express lanes during peak hours.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to prohibiting commercial motor vehicles in expresslanes during peak hours; and adding a new section to chapter 46.61 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 46.61 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The department of transportation and the local authoritiesshall prohibit all commercial motor vehicles, as defined in RCW46.25.010, from utilizing express lanes during peak traffic hours. Aviolation of this prohibition constitutes a traffic offense. (2) For the purposes of this section: (a) "Express lanes" means highway lanes that are reversible, usedto relieve congestion from the transportation system, and establishedand operated by the department of transportation; (b) "Peak traffic hours" means Monday through Friday from 6:00 a.m.to 10:00 a.m. and 3:00 p.m. to 7:00 p.m.
